text: We are about to submit, and indeed there are a number of documents such as birth certificates, etc. that are digital. First, I wrote an email to the Ministry of the Interior some time ago and they replied that they were not aware of this. I sent them a letter from the Philippines saying that there is no longer a printed apostille for birth certificates, marriage certificates/personal status. In the meantime, I am waiting for an answer. If there is no option, the only way that comes to my mind is to verify the digital certificate with an Israeli notary.
